root_cause.text: The `shmem_sg_alloc_table` function in the i915 DRM driver fails to limit the number of pages appended to a scatterlist segment based on its remaining capacity, allowing the 32-bit unsigned integer `length` field of the `scatterlist` structure to overflow when allocating pages from large folios.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that in `shmem_sg_alloc_table`, the number of pages (`nr_pages`) allocated is now capped by `max_segment / PAGE_SIZE`, and when appending to an existing scatterlist, it is further restricted to `(max_segment - sg->length) / PAGE_SIZE` to prevent `sg->length` from overflowing, replacing the commented warning `/* XXX: could overflow? */`.
